create_fastvlm_config: create a FastVlmConfig instance with default FastVLM-7B style configuration for conditional generation
initialize_vision_text_configs: initialize vision and text sub-configs from dictionaries or use defaults for fast_vlm model architecture
validate_fastvlm_architecture: validate fast_vlm config architecture ensuring vision_feature_select_strategy is 'full' and vision_feature_layer is -1
build_fastvlm_model_from_config: build a FastVlmForConditionalGeneration model from a FastVlmConfig instance for multimodal image-text generation
configure_fastvlm_projector_settings: configure fast_vlm projector settings including hidden act, image token index, image seq length, and multimodal projector bias
